quests.instruction: Which one is a cheesy food sliced into triangle pieces?
quests.question: Pizza
quests.hint: You can pick your own toppings for it.
quests.explanation: Correct! Pizza is a cheesy food sliced into triangle pieces.
quests.funFact: This food was first made in Italy long ago!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a warm liquid food with vegetables or noodles inside.
quests.question: Soup
quests.hint: It's served steaming hot in a bowl.
quests.explanation: Super! Soup is a warm liquid food with vegetables or noodles inside.
quests.funFact: Eating this warm dish can help your body feel better when you're sick!

quests.instruction: Which one is a sweet food topped with candles to celebrate a birthday?
quests.question: Cake
quests.hint: It's the special treat at a birthday party.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Cake is a sweet food topped with candles to celebrate a birthday.
quests.funFact: Long ago, this treat was made just like sweet bread!

quests.instruction: Which food is a crunchy sweet snack dipped in a glass of milk?
quests.question: Cookie
quests.hint: Chocolate chips are often baked right inside it.
quests.explanation: You found it! Cookie is a crunchy sweet snack dipped in a glass of milk.
quests.funFact: The biggest one ever baked was wider than a swimming pool!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a shiny round fruit teachers sometimes get as a gift.
quests.question: Apple
quests.hint: Its skin can be red, green, or yellow.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Apple is a shiny round fruit teachers sometimes get as a gift.
quests.funFact: There are more than 7,000 different kinds grown around the world!

quests.instruction: Which one is a flat round bread topped with cheese and sauce?
quests.question: Pizza
quests.hint: It arrives at your door in a big flat box.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Pizza is a flat round bread topped with cheese and sauce.
quests.funFact: The most popular topping in the world is plain cheese!

quests.instruction: Tap the food that is a cozy dish that can help you feel better when you're sick.
quests.question: Soup
quests.hint: It can have noodles, veggies, or chicken inside.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Soup is a cozy dish that can help you feel better when you're sick.
quests.funFact: Some kinds take hours of slow cooking to taste just right!

quests.instruction: Which one is a food with a yellow yolk hiding inside a white shell?
quests.question: Egg
quests.hint: A hen sits on a nest to lay this.
quests.explanation: Yes! Egg is a food with a yellow yolk hiding inside a white shell.
quests.funFact: A hen can lay one of these almost every single day!

quests.instruction: Which one is a yellow food made from milk that melts on pizza?
quests.question: Cheese
quests.hint: It's made from milk, not from fruit or grain.
quests.explanation: That's right! Cheese is a yellow food made from milk that melts on pizza.
quests.funFact: It takes about 10 cups of milk to make just one cup of this food!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a food you crack open before cooking it.
quests.question: Egg
quests.hint: It can be scrambled, fried, or boiled.
quests.explanation: Great job! Egg is a food you crack open before cooking it.
quests.funFact: The color of the shell depends on the hen's feathers!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a cheesy, saucy food you fold in half to eat.
quests.question: Pizza
quests.hint: It's round, cheesy, and often shared with friends.
quests.explanation: You got it! Pizza is a cheesy, saucy food you fold in half to eat.
quests.funFact: A giant one was once made as wide as a football field!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a round baked treat kept in a jar on the counter.
quests.question: Cookie
quests.hint: A special jar is used to store these treats.
quests.explanation: Well done! Cookie is a round baked treat kept in a jar on the counter.
quests.funFact: This treat's name comes from a word meaning 'little cake'!

quests.instruction: Which food do you know that is a frozen dessert that melts fast in the sun?
quests.question: Ice Cream
quests.hint: A scoop of it sits on top of a crunchy cone.
quests.explanation: Correct! Ice Cream is a frozen dessert that melts fast in the sun.
quests.funFact: Long ago, people made this treat by flavoring snow!

quests.instruction: Which one is an oval food with a shell that chickens lay?
quests.question: Egg
quests.hint: You crack its shell before cooking it.
quests.explanation: Super! Egg is an oval food with a shell that chickens lay.
quests.funFact: Spinning one on a table can show if it's boiled or raw!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a food made from milk that can be soft or hard.
quests.question: Cheese
quests.hint: It can be soft and creamy or hard and sharp.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Cheese is a food made from milk that can be soft or hard.
quests.funFact: There are over 1,000 different kinds made around the world!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a white drink that comes from cows.
quests.question: Milk
quests.hint: It's poured over cereal in the morning.
quests.explanation: You found it! Milk is a white drink that comes from cows.
quests.funFact: A single cow can fill many glasses of this drink every day!

quests.instruction: Which one is a small crispy treat baked on a tray in the oven?
quests.question: Cookie
quests.hint: It's small, round, and baked on a tray.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Cookie is a small crispy treat baked on a tray in the oven.
quests.funFact: Bakers first made these to test if the oven was ready!

quests.instruction: Tap the food that is small grains that turn soft and sticky when boiled.
quests.question: Rice
quests.hint: Many families around the world eat it every day.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Rice is small grains that turn soft and sticky when boiled.
quests.funFact: More people around the world eat this grain than any other!

quests.instruction: Tap the food that is a curved yellow fruit you peel before eating.
quests.question: Banana
quests.hint: You peel off its yellow skin before taking a bite.
quests.explanation: Terrific! Banana is a curved yellow fruit you peel before eating.
quests.funFact: This fruit is actually a berry, even though strawberries are not!

quests.instruction: Which food is a drink that comes home in cartons and jugs?
quests.question: Milk
quests.hint: It comes in cartons and jugs at the store.
quests.explanation: Yes! Milk is a drink that comes home in cartons and jugs.
quests.funFact: It's used to make cheese, butter, and yogurt too!

quests.instruction: Point to the food that is a warm meal served hot in a bowl on cold days.
quests.question: Soup
quests.hint: It's the cozy food people eat when they have a cold.
quests.explanation: That's right! Soup is a warm meal served hot in a bowl on cold days.
quests.funFact: Almost every country in the world has its own special kind!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a soft sweet dessert often covered in frosting?
quests.question: Cake
quests.hint: A sweet frosting is spread all over it.
quests.explanation: Great job! Cake is a soft sweet dessert often covered in frosting.
quests.funFact: The tallest ones have many layers stacked on top!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a sweet treat left out for Santa on Christmas Eve.
quests.question: Cookie
quests.hint: It's the sweet snack left out for Santa.
quests.explanation: You got it! Cookie is a sweet treat left out for Santa on Christmas Eve.
quests.funFact: The biggest one ever baked was wider than a swimming pool!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a soft food we tear into pieces to dip in soup.
quests.question: Bread
quests.hint: You can tear off a soft piece to dunk in soup.
quests.explanation: Well done! Bread is a soft food we tear into pieces to dip in soup.
quests.funFact: People have been baking this food for thousands of years!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a round baked food with tomato sauce and toppings?
quests.question: Pizza
quests.hint: Melted cheese stretches when you pull a slice away.
quests.explanation: Correct! Pizza is a round baked food with tomato sauce and toppings.
quests.funFact: This food was first made in Italy long ago!

quests.instruction: Point to the one that is a cold creamy treat scooped into a bowl.
quests.question: Ice Cream
quests.hint: It comes in flavors like chocolate and strawberry.
quests.explanation: Super! Ice Cream is a cold creamy treat scooped into a bowl.
quests.funFact: Vanilla is one of the most popular flavors in the world!

quests.instruction: Can you find the one that is a warm dish eaten with a spoon from a bowl?
quests.question: Soup
quests.hint: You need a spoon to eat this warm dish.
quests.explanation: Nice work! Soup is a warm dish eaten with a spoon from a bowl.
quests.funFact: Eating this warm dish can help your body feel better when you're sick!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a round baked treat cut into slices at parties.
quests.question: Cake
quests.hint: Everyone gets a slice at the party.
quests.explanation: You found it! Cake is a round baked treat cut into slices at parties.
quests.funFact: People sing a special song before eating this treat!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a creamy food that stretches when it's warm and melted.
quests.question: Cheese
quests.hint: Cartoon mice always seem to love this food.
quests.explanation: Exactly right! Cheese is a creamy food that stretches when it's warm and melted.
quests.funFact: Some kinds are aged in caves for extra flavor!

quests.instruction: Tap the one that is a soft fruit that's easy to mash for baby food.
quests.question: Banana
quests.hint: It's soft enough to mash with a fork.
quests.explanation: Wonderful! Banana is a soft fruit that's easy to mash for baby food.
quests.funFact: It grows in bunches called hands, hanging on its plant!
